text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 62 vials of droperidol 2.5 mg/mL, 2 mL (9.1 days on hand at 6.8 vials/day). Corvale General holds 113 vials (13.2 days on hand at 8.5 vials/day). FDA's drug shortage list does not include droperidol as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): The current label for NDC 00143951425 identifies HIKMA FARMACEUTICA (PORTUGAL), S.A. as the manufacturing plant. That plant was last inspected VAI on 2023-04-21. It received an OAI classification on 2014-03-28 and a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21. Subsequent inspections in 2015, 2016, 2020, and 2023 were classified VAI. American Regent, Inc.'s plant was last inspected VAI on 2024-04-24.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 9 to 13 days. No FDA shortage listing exists. The Hikma plant has a history of regulatory action but recent inspections are VAI. American Regent offers a VAI-inspected alternative source.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase order with American Regent, Inc. — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer confirms delivery schedule and allocates stock to Corvale East and Corvale General — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer monitors daily usage and updates days-on-hand weekly — requires Pharmacy Manager approval.

Not recommended: No allocation changes or clinical restrictions at this time.
